description: Declared platform matrix for the self-contained sap-adt runtime. 'status' is maintained explicitly: 'verified-local' and 'verified-ci' require a real native build + install smoke on that OS/arch, locally or in CI respectively. Never mark a target verified from a script's existence alone.

windows-x86_64.notes: CLI 1.6.6 Windows x64 runtime built with Windows Python 3.12 via WSL interop on 2026-11-27 UTC; ZIP and isolated npm install passed diagnostic/debugger/execution cross-process smokes, including execute-only snippets with generic source writes disabled. Windows-local npm regressions: 42 passed, 5 platform-specific skips; 40 targeted executor Python tests passed with temporary official MinGit on the child process PATH. The 1.6.6 desktop installer was built with verified official portable Inno Setup 6.7.4 and passed native PATH cleanup tests, silent per-user install in a Unicode/space path, same-version upgrade and uninstall; synthetic configuration and user/machine PATH were preserved. Interactive wizard, actual PATH mutation, elevated installation, live Windows SAP access and live debugger attachment are unverified.

linux-x86_64.notes: CLI 1.6.6 verified on Ubuntu 24.04 glibc 2.39 (WSL2), 2026-11-27 UTC: 613 Python and 47 npm tests, clean wheel install and native npm diagnostic/debugger/execution cross-process smokes, including execute-only snippets with generic source writes disabled. New executor SAP reads verified metadata, bounded references, two-profile source/configuration comparisons and syntax/ATC. The standard-class Unit run executed zero tests, not passing Unit evidence; available TR/dump lists were empty, so nonempty success paths remain fixture-tested. Coverage and abaplint use supplied bound reports, not attested native instrumentation. See executor.md and historical DEV acceptance in core-workflows.md. glibc floor applies to other distros; do not generalize to musl/older glibc without a real build there. Live debugger attachment is unverified.

darwin-aarch64.notes: Experimental CLI 1.6.6 macOS 15+ Apple Silicon runtime, verified 2026-11-27 UTC. Native macos-15 CI with Python 3.14 ran 613 Python tests (3 skips) and 47 npm tests (46 passed, 1 skip), passed runtime build and isolated npm diagnostic/debugger/execution cross-process smokes: Actions run 46073493281, source cb7b743b5f497af398773618ddcdb2b014a68d3a. Execution smokes keep generic source writes disabled. No personal Mac, older macOS, live SAP, Keychain, Gatekeeper/quarantine, signing or notarization verification.
